notes.subject: long hap we solwara i stap
notes.rationale: ימה i tok 'long hap bilong solwara' — arere we solwara i stap, man i kolim 'wes'

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat kopula — nasi ⟨em⟩ Eliszama

notes.subject: machane na nasi
notes.rationale: Stori i makim ples bilong machane na nem bilong lider — pasin bilong kaunim na stretim ol lain

translation: Flag bilong machane bilong Efrayim, long olgeta bilong ol ami bilong ol, i stap long hap we solwara i stap; na nasi bilong ol pikinini bilong Efrayim ⟨em⟩ Eliszama, pikinini bilong Amihud.
